### **Job Description**


**About CivicDataLab**
======================

We work at the intersection of data, technology, design and social science to strengthen the data\-for\-public\-good ecosystem and citizen participation in governance. CivicDataLab (CDL) harnesses the potential of open knowledge movements to strengthen the data\-for\-public\-good ecosystem and enable citizens to engage in matters of public reform. We work closely with governments, non\-profits, think\-tanks, media houses and universities to enhance their data and technology capacity to better data\-driven decision\-making at scale.  

  



Our current areas of expertise include digital public goods \& infrastructure (DPGs \& DPI), climate action, public finance, urban development, open contracting and law \& justice. We have co\-created digital public goods like open data platforms, data exchanges, AI models and citizen\-led apps for improving participatory data\-driven governance in India and other countries.  

  



**What are we looking for**
===========================

We seek a dynamic professional with 3\-5 years of experience to lead our **data and AI\-driven projects** for the public good. This role involves working closely with civil societies and non\-profits, government partners (senior bureaucrats, ministries and various departments), industry experts and multilateral institutions, as well as managing a multidisciplinary internal team of technologists, data strategists, domain experts, designers and researchers, to ensure high\-quality execution of impact\-driven projects.  

  



The ideal candidate will have experience navigating public sector environments, a strong understanding of data and technology systems, and a keen ability to translate strategic goals into executable project plans.  

  



In this role, you will be giving 25% of your time towards exploring new project opportunities and supporting scaling or expansion of initiatives, 65% towards managing and implementing ongoing projects, and the remaining 10% on broader organisational responsibilities.  

  



  

### **Requirements**


**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Programme Planning and Management**  

  



* Plan and manage capacity\-building cohorts from outreach and onboarding through delivery, evaluation and handover.
* Maintain work plans, schedules, budgets, project trackers, risk logs and clear ownership of tasks across multiple workstreams.
* Coordinate internal teams, facilitators and external partners to keep activities and deliverables on schedule.
* Anticipate recruitment, engagement and delivery risks, and develop practical backup plans.

**Partnerships and Participant Engagement**  

  



* Build relationships with nonprofits, funders and ecosystem organisations to support outreach and recruitment.
* Manage applications, selection, onboarding and regular communication with participating organisations.
* Serve as the primary operational contact for participants, responding to queries and connecting them with the right technical or learning support.
* Monitor participation, follow up where engagement drops and help create opportunities for peer learning.

**Delivery and Quality Management**  

  



* Organise virtual sessions, in\-person workshops and mentoring activities, including logistics, materials, access and facilitator schedules.
* Coordinate with the curriculum lead and subject experts to ensure sessions and learning materials are ready on time.
* Support baseline assessments, feedback collection and end\-line evaluation. Maintain accurate attendance and engagement records.
* Prepare progress updates, meeting notes and documentation required for reporting and future reuse of the programme.

**Field Engagement and Travel**  

  



* Coordinate with participating organisations and local partners during workshops and field activities.
* Travel for programme activities when required outside of Delhi if need be.

**What is Required**  

  



* At least 3 to 5 years of experience managing cohorts, training programmes, partnerships or multi\-stakeholder initiatives, preferably in the nonprofit or social impact sector.
* Strong understanding of digital products, data and AI tools, including familiarity with relevant vocabulary, use of AI tools, product development cycles, APIs, data visualisation trends, and commonly used tools.
* Understanding of data governance, open data, data privacy, civic technology, and public policy.
* Strong planning, coordination, documentation and problem\-solving skills, with experience managing several activities at once.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work with partners, participants and multidisciplinary teams.
* Hands\-on familiarity with tools like G Suite, Slack, spreadsheets, shared documents, forms, virtual meeting tools and project management platforms to track delivery and report progress.
* Demonstrated experience in managing multi\-stakeholder initiatives with a focus on impact and delivery.
* Excellent communication and problem\-solving abilities, with experience handling on\-ground complexities and government interactions
**How we work**
===============

CivicDataLab is based out of Delhi and has the presence of project teams located in Assam, Odisha, and Himachal Pradesh. We follow a hybrid model where our bandhus work out of the office for a minimum of 12 days per month (i.e) 3 days a week. We use open\-source tools and agile methodologies in organising our work.  

  



  

  

### **Benefits**


**Perks of Working with Us**
============================

***Wellness Allowance***
------------------------

At CivicDataLab, we always emphasise the wellness of our bandhus. This includes any Expenditure done for the purpose of Wellness Setup, except any financial instrument, any expense that can be claimed as a deductible expense under Income Tax rules, any goods and services that attract a combined tax, cess or duty of more than 28%. If you're interested in taking classes that enhance your overall physical or mental well\-being, you have an **INR 60,000** annual stipend to do so. For some people, that might mean a monthly massage. Some take photography lessons or learn a musical instrument or buy a gym membership. It's up to you; the point is to learn something that you feel enriches you as a person.  

  



***Professional growth and development Allowance***
---------------------------------------------------

At CivicDataLab, we encourage everyone to take up things that help one grow professionally, and you get an annual kitty of INR 60,000 to do so. This includes attending or speaking at conferences and workshops, taking courses, acquiring hardware or software licenses or even joining summer schools. We feel that learning a skill should never be a hurdle to solve important problems for the community.

*Please note: This figure includes both fixed remuneration, perks and Incidental components such as salary, statutory benefits, professional development, wellness, travel infrastructure, and other operational support costs incurred by the organisation.*  

  



Our Commitment to Diversity  

  



We are committed to inclusive hiring and strongly encourage applicants from diverse and underrepresented gender and caste identities and/or sociocultural backgrounds to apply for this role. Our organisational policies are gender\-neutral, including POSH policy and leave policy. We provide 6 months of paid time off as parental leave for the primary caregiver and 6 weeks of paid time off for the secondary caregiver, including adoption.

title: Program Manager, IPs & Events
description:
Inc42 is India's \#1 media and intelligence platform on the startup economy, covering journalism, Datalabs (India's largest free startup database, with 75,000\+ companies), our flagship editorial IPs (AI Summit, D2C \& Retail Summit, FAST42, D2C Retreat, CTO Summit, MoneyX Dialogues), and Griffin, India's most curated private founder club.  

Our IPs are rooms, not conferences. They are curated, selection is never sold, and the people in the room are the product.### **Why this role exists**


Inc42 runs five to seven tentpole IPs a year, plus a set of smaller retreats, dinners and closed\-door programmes. Each edition is assembled across five teams that sit in different parts of the company: delivery, events operations, account management, marketing and design. Today that assembly is convened by a founder, by hand, edition by edition.  

We are hiring Program Managers to own that assembly. You will run two to three IPs end to end, or a full season of them: the calendar, the T\-minus timeline, every dependency and go\-live date, the cost sheet, the live delivery tracker, and the retro. The founders keep the editorial call and the sponsor call. You make the whole thing ship, on the date, on the number, without anyone above you having to chase.  

This is the first rung of a ladder we are building deliberately. The people who run two IPs well will run four; the person who runs six will lead the portfolio.### **What you'll own**

* **The programme, end to end:** for each IP you hold, the annual date, the edition scope, the T\-minus plan from ninety days out, the dependency map across content, marketing, design, operations, account management and speakers, and the go\-live sequence for the website, the agenda and the room.
* **The tracker that everyone works from:** one live view per IP with stage, owner and due date. You keep it true. When something slips, you know three weeks before delivery does, and you say so.
* **The cost sheet:** vendor, venue, production and travel economics for each edition, built early, updated as decisions land, reconciled after. You will make the model\-level cost calls with the founders (six hundred people or four hundred, dinner or lunch, how many VIP tiers) and hold the envelope once it is set.
* **The convening:** a weekly cadence per live IP that brings five teams into one room and leaves with named owners and dates. You will be the neck below the founders that every cross\-team question goes to first.
* **Quality control, ensured not done:** you do not write the agenda or design the deck. You make sure the people who do have what they need, on time, and that the founder review happens once and early rather than five times and late.
* **The retro:** what shipped, what slipped, what we fix next edition, written within a week of the room closing.

### **Who you are**

* **You have run programmes to a date with many moving parts:** a launch calendar, an accelerator cohort, a live\-events bet inside a consumer company, a chief\-of\-staff seat where you owned the operating rhythm. Something with real dependencies, real vendors and a day it had to be done.
* **You are precise about operations and honest about slippage:** you keep the tracker true even when the truth is uncomfortable, and you escalate early rather than heroically late.
* **You convene without authority:** you have made senior people from other teams show up, commit and deliver without being their manager.
* **You are good with a cost sheet:** you have built one, owned one, and been held to one.
* **You build systems as you go:** templates, checklists, the T\-minus that gets reused. You would rather fix the process than run the same fire drill twice.
* You use AI as a working tool, for first drafts, research, summaries and versioning, and you know where it stops and judgment starts.
* **You have taste for rooms:** you understand why a smaller, better room beats a bigger one, and you have an opinion about it.


Open on industry. We are not looking for people who have run conferences; we are looking for people who have shipped complex things on time and want to learn how a curated room is made.### **What we offer**

* Ownership of named IPs that India's founders, investors and operators already plan their year around.
* A visible ladder: Program Manager to Senior Program Manager to the portfolio seat, with the criteria written down.
* A small team, decisions in the room, direct access to the founders and to the people who build the rooms.
* Compensation aligned to experience, plus meaningful ESOPs.
* Delhi\-based, in\-person. Travel for editions.

description:
**1\. Role Purpose**

The Head of Operations will be responsible for leading and controlling the **end\-to\-end operational delivery of Geographics Interiors LLP’s projects** across locations.

The role will ensure that projects are delivered **on time, within approved budgets, as per quality standards, safely and in line with client expectations**, while maintaining operational efficiency and project profitability.

The position will act as the **single\-point operational authority** between Management, Projects, Design, MEP, Procurement, Commercial/Accounts, Vendors, Contractors and Site Teams.

**2\. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Project Execution \& Delivery**

* Lead the execution of multiple interior fit\-out and turnkey projects simultaneously.
* Take overall ownership of project delivery from project handover to final client handover.
* Ensure project execution is aligned with approved drawings, BOQ, specifications, timelines and commercial commitments.
* Review project schedules, milestones and critical\-path activities.
* Monitor planned vs. actual progress and take corrective action wherever required.
* Identify project delays, bottlenecks and dependencies at an early stage.
* Ensure timely completion, snag closure and final handover.
* Conduct regular project review meetings with Project Managers and Site Teams.

**B. Operations \& Resource Planning**

* Plan and allocate Project Managers, Site Engineers, Supervisors, MEP resources and other manpower based on project requirements.
* Ensure optimum utilization of manpower across all active projects.
* Identify manpower gaps and arrange timely deployment.
* Review site productivity and team performance.
* Develop a structured manpower/resource deployment plan for upcoming projects.
* Ensure no critical project is affected due to resource shortages.

**C. Project Management Team Leadership**

* Lead and mentor Project Managers, Site Engineers and operational teams.
* Establish clear accountability and ownership for every project.
* Set project\-level performance expectations and review them periodically.
* Monitor PM/site team performance through measurable KPIs.
* Resolve internal conflicts and operational issues.
* Develop a culture of ownership, discipline and timely execution.

**D. Procurement \& Vendor Coordination**

* Coordinate closely with Purchase/Procurement for project material requirements.
* Ensure timely submission of material requisitions based on project schedules.
* Monitor material availability against project requirements.
* Track critical materials and long\-lead items.
* Coordinate with vendors, contractors and subcontractors for timely execution.
* Monitor vendor/contractor performance, quality and delivery commitments.
* Escalate procurement delays that may impact project timelines.
* Support commercial teams in vendor negotiations and operational decisions.

**E. Cost Control \& Project Profitability**

* Monitor project costs against approved budgets and BOQs.
* Review manpower productivity, material wastage, rework and subcontractor costs.
* Identify cost overruns at an early stage.
* Monitor project variations, additional works and client changes.
* Ensure commercial implications of project decisions are communicated to Management/Commercial teams.
* Work with Accounts/Commercial teams to monitor project profitability and cost\-to\-complete.
* Drive cost optimization without compromising quality or delivery.

**F. Client \& Stakeholder Management**

* Act as a senior escalation point for key clients and project stakeholders.
* Participate in important client meetings and project reviews.
* Maintain strong professional relationships with clients, consultants, architects and PMC representatives.
* Resolve critical operational issues and client escalations.
* Ensure commitments made to clients are properly communicated to internal teams and tracked to closure.
* Support the Project Team in achieving high client satisfaction and successful handovers.

**G. Design, Technical \& MEP Coordination**

* Ensure smooth coordination between Design, Projects and Site Teams.
* Review critical design/drawing issues affecting execution.
* Ensure drawings, BOQs, specifications and site requirements are aligned before execution.
* Coordinate with MEP, Civil, Interior and other specialist teams.
* Ensure technical issues and RFIs are resolved within required timelines.
* Prevent execution delays arising from design or coordination gaps.

**H. Quality \& Safety**

* Establish and monitor project quality standards across all sites.
* Ensure execution is as per approved drawings, specifications and quality standards.
* Implement project quality checklists and inspection systems.
* Monitor workmanship, material quality and installation standards.
* Drive systematic snagging and snag closure.
* Ensure pre\-handover quality inspections are completed.
* Ensure compliance with company safety requirements and applicable site safety standards.
* Take immediate corrective action on serious quality or safety concerns.

**I. SOP \& Process Improvement**

* Develop, implement and continuously improve Operations SOPs.
* Standardize processes from project handover through execution and final handover.
* Establish clear workflows between:
* **Sales → Design → BOQ/Estimation → Procurement → Projects → Site → Commercial → Handover**
* Identify operational inefficiencies and introduce corrective systems.
* Implement standard project review formats, reporting systems and escalation mechanisms.
* Ensure SOP compliance across projects.**J. MIS \& Management Reporting**

Submit regular Operations MIS to the Management covering:

* Project\-wise progress
* Planned vs. actual completion
* Project\-wise manpower
* Material status
* Procurement delays
* Cost/budget status
* Project profitability
* Vendor/contractor performance
* Quality issues
* Safety concerns
* Client escalations
* Project risks
* Critical decisions required from Management
* Upcoming project resource requirements

**K. Risk \& Escalation Management**

* Maintain a project risk register for major projects.
* Identify risks related to manpower, material, design, procurement, client approvals, vendors and timelines.
* Ensure timely escalation of critical matters to Management.
* Develop recovery plans for delayed projects.
* Monitor corrective actions until closure.
* Ensure operational issues are resolved at the appropriate level without unnecessary escalation.

**3\. Key Performance Areas / KPIs**

The Head of Operations will be measured on:

* **On\-Time Project Delivery**
* **Project Budget \& Cost Control**
* **Project Gross Margin / Profitability**
* **Manpower Productivity \& Utilization**
* **Material Availability \& Procurement Efficiency**
* **Quality Compliance**
* **Snag Closure \& Handover Performance**
* **Client Satisfaction \& Escalation Closure**
* **Vendor \& Contractor Performance**
* **Safety \& Site Compliance**
* **SOP Implementation \& Process Discipline**
* **Accuracy and Timeliness of Operations MIS**
* **Project Risk Identification \& Resolution**
* **Overall Operational Efficiency**

**4\. Decision\-Making Authority**

The Head of Operations will have authority to:

* Recommend/approve operational manpower deployment within approved structures.
* Reallocate project resources based on business priorities.
* Escalate underperforming vendors/contractors.
* Recommend replacement of non\-performing project resources.
* Direct corrective actions for project delays and quality issues.
* Escalate commercial deviations and project risks to Management.
* Recommend process improvements and operational SOP changes.
* Recommend additional manpower, vendors or resources based on project requirements.

Major commercial commitments, salary decisions, contractual commitments and deviations beyond approved budgets will remain subject to Management approval.

The Project Engineer – Operations role exists to strengthen how construction projects are planned, coordinated, and delivered by ensuring that accurate, timely, and actionable information flows seamlessly across teams. This role transforms design data, BIM models, and project documentation into clear guidance that supports predictable outcomes, reduces risk, and improves decision\-making throughout the project lifecycle.


By proactively identifying issues, improving constructability, and supporting disciplined workflows, the Project Engineer enables project teams to move from reactive problem\-solving to confident execution.

**Responsibility and Focus Areas:**
-----------------------------------

**Document \& Models Management** – Understand, analyze, and manage the versions of construction documents \& models on cloud platform ensuring the latest and greatest information is available to field team. The process can involve various Project Management Platforms like ACC Build, Procore, Bluebeam etc.

**RFI Management** – Early identification of the potential RFI’s (Request for Information) on a project through Drawings \& Model based review and coordination, also understanding the raised RFI to identify appropriate details and portions of drawings impacted by RFI and link the same on the drawings for every stakeholder’s awareness.

**Submittal Management** – Understanding the project specifications and interpreting it to create submittal log. Assist the project team in creating, tracking, and managing the submittal on Project Management Platforms

**Change Management** – Through the updated Drawings and Models, assisting the project in tracking and reflecting the cost changes (due to changes in Drawings, RFI or any other factor) on the Project Management Platforms. Also, generating a scope change report by comparing the revised drawings against the current set of drawings, to help the project teams in validating cost changes.

**Construction Document \& Design Review** – Review various construction documents like Design Drawings, Construction Drawings, Shop Drawings, Submittals and RFIs in the preconstruction phase to identify inconsistencies, incomplete information, and constructability issues.

**Model Based Coordination** – Leveraging BIM, identify and resolve spatial and temporal conflicts between trades virtually thereby preempting them in the field which could be costly and can derail the project schedule. Identify data inconsistencies using Navisworks.

**Quality check** models for completeness, accuracy and constructability based on design drawings and construction know\-how. Use automation wherever possible.


Use **Data Visualization** means to track metrics, indicators for project progress, and quality.

* Identify opportunities to improve workflows and tools.
* Partner with innovation teams on automation and AI initiatives.
* Document lessons learned and best practices.

The day begins with reviewing priorities, open items, and any risks that need attention. Short conversations with project managers, engineers, and field teams help align what needs to move first. You support client check ins by preparing updates or clarifying next steps. You also explore improvements in the way work is done by trying new tools or refining steps that can reduce rework. Before wrapping up, you capture key learnings, update trackers, and prepare for what the next day will require.

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, or Construction Management.
* 2\-5 years of experience in construction operations and/or BIM
